description.value: Savary Island Pie Company is a Tofino bakery and cafe with over 30 years of handcrafting sweet and savoury pies, fresh pastries, and all-day breakfast and lunch using pure ingredients with no gums or preservatives. The Tofino location serves its famous Ciabiscuit egg sandwiches, freshly baked goods, and coffee alongside a full pie menu. It is a well-established local institution and a natural fuelling stop for cyclists riding the Pacific Rim corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Savary Island Pie Company operates a real, active Tofino bakery/cafe location serving all-day breakfast, lunch, coffee, and baked goods, with phone number (250) 725-1228 matching the OSM tag. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via the repeated website notice directing Tofino customers to call and place orders for pickup. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi (despite OSM internet_access=yes), or other cyclist-specific amenities appears in the website content, so those are marked null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM tags internet_access=yes and internet_access:fee=no could not be confirmed from website content; marked null rather than true.

Business has two locations (Tofino and West Vancouver); some website features (online ordering, jam promotions) are West Vancouver-only — the Tofino location requires phone orders. No address confirmation was available from the truncated contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe and bakery in Tofino with a confirmed website and phone number, serving food and coffee to walk-in and call-ahead customers.

Takeout.detail: Website repeatedly states 'Online orders are not available for pickup in Tofino. Please call us at (250) 725-1228 to place your order directly,' confirming phone-order takeout/pickup is available at the Tofino location

wow_evidence: over 30 years of handcrafting sweet and savoury pies...well-established local institution
